layers.process: Caesarea National Park: adult NIS 46, child NIS 27, group adult NIS 39, group child NIS 23, student NIS 39. Summer 08:00 to 17:00 (Fridays and holiday eves to 16:00), winter 08:00 to 16:00 (Fridays and holiday eves to 15:00); the entrance closes one hour before. On holidays and Saturdays entry depends on available space. The Harbour Visitors' Centre page gives lower figures (NIS 39 adult), so the main page figure may be newer.

zone-requirements.note: Fees and hours were read from extracts of the Authority's pages on 2026-11-07 (direct fetch returned HTTP 403). Some pages are a year or two old and the Authority's own pages disagree in places, so confirm in its booking system. No RBA rate for ILS is held in this repo, so no A$ figure is given.

closures: Caesarea National Park: summer Sunday-Thursday/Saturday 08:00-17:00, Friday/holiday-eve row 08:00-16:00; winter Sunday-Thursday/Saturday 08:00-16:00, Friday/holiday-eve row 08:00-15:00. A separate holiday-eve/Yom Kippur-eve listing closes at 13:00. Entry closes one hour before the applicable closing time. Hours are site-local, not AEST.

laws.rule: Caesarea: dogs are allowed leashed AND muzzled, except in the Visitors' Center. On holidays and Saturdays the authority recommends arriving early and says entry depends on available space. The page also says the Caesarea Experience display near the Roman Theater has not yet opened; this undated notice is not a promise about every other area or future opening.
